zh: Camellia：NTT 与三菱电机 2000 年设计的 128 位 Feistel 分组密码。
128 位块：Camellia 的明文和密文单位，分成左右各 64 位。
128/192/256 位密钥：Camellia 的三种密钥长度；128 位用 18 轮，192/256 位用 24 轮。
18/24 轮：128 位密钥的轮数，以及 192/256 位密钥的轮数。
Feistel 结构：每轮交换左右半区、由 F 函数混合的迭代结构。
FL/FL^-1：每 6 轮插入的 32 位半字层，用与、或和一位旋转混合密钥。
F 函数：Camellia 的轮函数，等于 P(S(X XOR k))。
S 函数：按字节用 s1、s2、s3、s4、s2、s3、s4、s1 替换的 64 位函数。
P 函数：对八个字节做固定异或线性组合的 64 位函数。
S-box：四个 8 位替换表；s2、s3、s4 由 s1 的 8 位旋转导出。
KL/KR：由密钥长度决定的两个 128 位密钥变量。
KA/KB：用 F 函数和 Sigma 常数从 KL、KR 导出的两个 128 位变量；KB 只用于 192/256 位密钥。
Sigma 常数：六个 64 位密钥调度常数，取自素数平方根的十六进制位。
预白化/后白化：首轮前和后轮后分别 XOR kw1||kw2 与 kw3||kw4。
子密钥 kw/k/ke：白化子密钥、轮子密钥和 FL 层子密钥。
CMS：RFC 3657 规定的 Camellia 内容加密和密钥包装用法。
OpenPGP：RFC 5581 引入、RFC 9580 保留编号 11/12/13 的可选 Camellia 用法。
TLS：RFC 5932 和 RFC 6367 为 TLS 1.2 定义的 Camellia CBC/GCM 套件；TLS 1.3 没有 Camellia 套件。
en: Camellia: the 128-bit Feistel block cipher designed by NTT and Mitsubishi Electric in 2000.
128-bit block: Camellia's plaintext and ciphertext unit, split into two 64-bit halves.
128/192/256-bit keys: Camellia's three key lengths; 128-bit keys use 18 rounds and 192/256-bit keys use 24.
18/24 rounds: the round count for 128-bit keys and for 192/256-bit keys.
Feistel structure: an iterated structure that swaps halves and mixes them through F.
FL/FL^-1: a 32-bit-half layer inserted after every six rounds, mixing key material with AND, OR and a one-bit rotation.
F function: Camellia's round function, equal to P(S(X XOR k)).
S function: a 64-bit bytewise substitution through s1, s2, s3, s4, s2, s3, s4 and s1.
P function: a 64-bit function applying fixed XOR combinations to the eight bytes.
S-box: one of four 8-bit substitution tables; s2, s3 and s4 are derived from s1 by 8-bit rotations.
KL/KR: the two 128-bit key variables determined by the key length.
KA/KB: two 128-bit variables derived from KL and KR with F and the Sigma constants; KB is used only for 192/256-bit keys.
Sigma constants: six 64-bit key-schedule constants taken from hexadecimal digits of prime square roots.
Prewhitening/postwhitening: XOR with kw1||kw2 before the first round and with kw3||kw4 after the last.
Subkeys kw/k/ke: whitening subkeys, round subkeys and FL-layer subkeys.
CMS: the Camellia content-encryption and key-wrap usage specified by RFC 3657.
OpenPGP: the optional Camellia usage introduced by RFC 5581 and kept as numbers 11/12/13 by RFC 9580.
TLS: the Camellia CBC/GCM suites defined for TLS 1.2 by RFC 5932 and RFC 6367; TLS 1.3 has no Camellia suite.
